title: Dream Body Recipe
author: Samuel Tenney
desc: Unlock your ideal physique with the **Dream Body Recipe**, a focused 1-week program designed to sculpt and strengthen your body through three dynamic training sessions. Each workout targets key muscle groups with a blend of machine and free weight exercises, ensuring balanced development and maximum results. From glute-boosting hip thrusts to upper body defining seated rows, this program delivers a comprehensive approach to fitness that fits seamlessly into your week. Get ready to transform your body and embrace the journey to your dream physique!
